question: What accompanied sacrifice is called hero-mixed, and who is guru in the middle?
premises: by all indeed accompanied, the sacrifice is called hero-mixed
in the middle, guru becomes theirs, the guru-group then covering
inference: All-accompanied rite is hero-mixed; guru-centering covers the group.
plain_english: By all indeed accompanied, the sacrifice is called hero-mixed — in the middle guru becomes theirs, the guru-group then covering.
